android-navigation|Top app bar.summary: A Plenix top app bar on Android is Material 3’s top app bar, kept native in behavior (the small, medium and large layouts, collapsing on scroll, the Back button, the status bar inset, ripple, TalkBack and font scaling) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the plain header surface, a 1 dp edge line once content scrolls under it instead of Material’s tint, a DM Sans title in the Plenix title role, and muted icons with 48 dp targets. Material’s default changes the bar to the surface container color on scroll; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.

variants.name: Small title
variants.use: Dense screens, detail screens and scrolled screens.

variants.name: Medium title
variants.compose: MediumTopAppBar (MediumFlexibleTopAppBar in the expressive API) with exitUntilCollapsedScrollBehavior()
variants.use: Screens that show a larger headline than the small bar; it collapses to the small bar on scroll.

variants.name: Large title
variants.compose: LargeTopAppBar (LargeFlexibleTopAppBar in the expressive API) with exitUntilCollapsedScrollBehavior()
variants.use: Top-level screens and screens whose headline matters; it collapses to the small bar on scroll.

variants.name: Search header
variants.compose: The Plenix search bar in the top app bar slot of the Scaffold
variants.views: SearchBar in the AppBarLayout, with its SearchView
variants.use: Home screens where search is the main entry.

variants.name: Selection
variants.material: Small app bar showing the selection
variants.compose: TopAppBar whose title is the number selected, Close as its navigation icon and the selection’s actions
variants.views: A second MaterialToolbar shown while items are selected, or startSupportActionMode
variants.use: While items are selected: the number selected and the actions for the selection.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.about: The bar across the top of the screen, below the status bar.

anatomy.name: Navigation icon
anatomy.about: Back on every screen below the start of its stack; Close while items are selected.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: The screen’s name in DM Sans; in the medium and large bars it starts large and collapses on scroll.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.about: One action at Narrow, two when necessary; the rest go in a toolbar.

anatomy.name: Edge
anatomy.about: A 1 dp line along the bottom, shown once content scrolls under the bar.
